caption: The drawing depicts a single rectangular box placed against a plain, light beige background. The box has a dark brown color with lighter brown and yellowish marbling or streaks throughout its surface, indicating a wood grain or marbled effect. The box has a flat lid with a beveled rectangular panel in the center, and appears to have some faint, possibly white writing or decoration along the top edge of the lid. There are two metal handles, one visible on the left side, and subtle yellowish accents along the edges and corners which may represent brass or gold-colored fixtures. The edges of the box are clearly defined, and the box itself is depicted in a three-quarters view, showing the front and left sides. In the lower right corner of the drawing, there is faint handwriting that reads "Willoughby Ross." The composition is centered, with the box occupying the middle area of the otherwise blank page.
title: Sea Chest, U.S. Navy
